# Account

The entity a user deploys and governs through the app. Two vocabularies name it.

## What an account is

An account holds assets and acts on-chain. It is the product term for what the protocol calls a DAO.

## Account and governor are distinct capabilities

The account is the vault and the actor; a governance process decides what it does.

### Metadata-backed display

The app shows the account name and avatar from its metadata.

## Open questions

- [ ] Should the explore page show the account creator?

Notes under the open question that must disappear too.

## Naming

Prefer "account" in product copy; say "DAO" only when the protocol contract itself is meant.
